description: This file defines the MyLeaveListController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the leave management plugin. It extends a base LeaveListController to customize the pre-rendering process by initializing a Vue component and setting various properties related to leave statuses, types, and date range selections.

classes.name: MyLeaveListController
classes.description: Controller handling the leave list view for the current user, customized with specific Vue component properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with leave-related properties before rendering the view. It creates a component instance, adds status and date range properties, and associates the component with the view.
